description: An awards producer must approve the binding audience-vote package for a live short-film ceremony, including the ballot method, station setup, accessibility provisions, vote-display policy, announcement format, and production follow-ups.

shared_context.S1: The live ceremony includes an audience-voted award for the best short film.
shared_context.S2: The audience-vote operating package has not yet been finalized.
shared_context.S3: Mara has authority to approve the final voting and announcement procedures.
shared_context.S4: As part of the normal ceremony preflight, Mara checks with audience services and broadcast compliance before approving the package.

PF1.text: Jonah's accessibility audit of the auditorium, completed after the draft package circulated, requires exactly four staffed ballot stations and large-print paper ballots available at every station; the audit report is still in the audience-services inbox.

PF2.text: Leila's review of the signed broadcaster license, completed this morning while reconciling the legal rider, requires paper ballots rather than electronic voting, prohibits displaying live vote totals, and requires the winner to be presented as a final tally rather than an on-screen running result; the rider has not yet been attached to the production packet.

acceptance_conditions: Exactly four staffed ballot stations must be provided.
Large-print paper ballots must be available at every station.
Live vote totals must not be displayed.
The winner must be presented as a final tally rather than a running result.
An accessibility ballot commitment must be logged.
A broadcaster-compliance commitment must be logged.

decisive_facts.why: The audit changes the station plan to exactly four staffed stations, requires large-print ballots at each one, and creates the accessibility ballot setup commitment.

The signed broadcaster license changes the voting method to paper ballots, changes live totals to prohibited, changes the announcement to final-tally-only, and requires the broadcaster-compliance commitment and citation.
